recommendedTextbook.title: Islamic Religious Studies for Junior Secondary Schools Book 3
recommendedTextbook.author: M. A. Folorunsho, A. K. Makinde
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Zakah and Sadaqah: Islamic Philanthropy and Poverty Alleviation
subtopics: Definition and difference between Zakah (obligatory tax) and Sadaqah (voluntary charity)
Nisab (minimum threshold) calculation on cash, gold, silver, crops, and livestock
The 8 statutory categories of Zakah recipients gazetted in Surah At-Tawbah (9:60)
objectives: Distinguish compulsory Zakah from voluntary everyday Sadaqah
Calculate 2.5% Zakatul-Mal on accumulated annual savings above the Nisab in Naira
Analyze how effective Zakah collection eradicates extreme poverty and inequality in Nigeria

topics.topic: Sawm (Fasting) in Ramadan and Health/Spiritual Virtues
subtopics: The obligation of fasting during the holy month of Ramadan (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:183)
Conditions, intentions, things that invalidate fasting, and exemptions (travelers, sick, elderly)
Spiritual benefits: Taqwa (God-consciousness), self-control, empathy for the hungry, Laylatul Qadr
objectives: Explain the theological definition and purpose of fasting prescribed in Surah Al-Baqarah
Identify categories of individuals granted statutory exemptions from fasting under Shariah
Outline the spiritual discipline cultivated through abstaining from food, drink, and foul speech

topics.topic: Hajj and Umrah: Rites, Sacred Sites and Spiritual Brotherhood
subtopics: Meaning and conditions for the obligation of Hajj (Islam, sanity, puberty, physical and financial capability)
Rites of Hajj: Ihram, Tawaf around the Ka'aba, Sa'y between Safa and Marwah, standing at Arafah, Jamarat
Spiritual symbolism: Total equality of all human races clothed in identical white Ihram garments
objectives: Differentiate between the major pilgrimage (Hajj) and the lesser pilgrimage (Umrah)
Explain why standing on the plain of Arafah on the 9th of Dhul-Hijjah is the pinnacle of Hajj
Assess how the international Hajj pilgrimage exemplifies global racial and ethnic equality

topics.topic: Commercial Ethics in Islam: Prohibition of Riba and Fraud
subtopics: Islamic business ethics: Honesty, truthfulness, mutual consent, accurate weights and measures
Prohibition of Riba (usury/interest) and extortionate financial contracts in Surah Al-Baqarah
Prohibition of cheating, hoarding (Ihtikar), selling adulterated or hazardous merchandise
objectives: State 4 core ethical principles governing commercial business transactions in Islam
Explain why the Quran strictly bans usurious interest (Riba) and exploitation of the poor
Describe the spiritual rewards promised to truthful and trustworthy merchants (At-Tajirul Amin)
